profile.name: SARTHAK KARKI
profile.tagline: Stochastic Optimization & Risk Intelligence for Critical Himalayan Infrastructure

projects.title: Reservoir Sediment Audit
projects.description: Automated pipeline for quantifying reservoir sedimentation liability. Uses USGS data to model long-term asset depreciation and revenue erosion.

projects.title: Slope Stability Engine
projects.description: Probabilistic risk engine translating hydrological data into quantifiable landslide failure probabilities. Calculates Factor of Safety (FoS) distributions based on AGS 2007 Guidelines.

projects.title: Geospatial Catchment Feasibility
projects.description: Intelligence engine quantifying runoff yield and access road slope risk. Prevents capital allocation to unbuildable sites using DEM analysis and hydrological modeling.

projects.title: Satellite Forensics NDVI
projects.description: Forensic tool using multispectral satellite data (Red/NIR) to detect land use change. Quantifies forest loss percentages to assess catchment degradation risks.

projects.title: Hydro Dispatch Optimizer
projects.description: Linear programming engine designed to maximize revenue against volatility. Solves for optimal hourly turbine dispatch schedules while enforcing hydraulic continuity constraints.

projects.title: TBM ROP Predictor
projects.description: XGBoost-driven predictive engine for Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) performance. Forecasts Advance Rates (ROP) from geological constraints to quantify schedule risk and prevent capital erosion.

projects.title: AICE Structural Health Monitor
projects.description: Implementation of Predictive Maintenance (PedM) and Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) algorithms. Uses time-series anomaly detection on real-world sensor data to predict infrastructure failure.
